citation: Hamer HM, Wall BT, Kiskini A, et al. Carbohydrate co-ingestion with protein does not further augment post-prandial muscle protein accretion in older men. Nutrition & Metabolism. 2013;10:15.
protocol: Liquid protein bolus: 450 mL drink with 20 g intrinsically labelled casein, with or without 40 g carbohydrate, in two parallel groups. Arterialised blood at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, ... 360 min (every 30 min after 60 min).
population: 24 healthy older men, 75 ± 1 y, BMI ≤30 (Table 1), 12 per arm; Netherlands (Maastricht).

reports.where: Results text: peak and iAUC for protein vs protein+carbohydrate

note: Pure-protein load in older men, against the same protein with carbohydrate; good for the protein-only insulin response at advanced age. Only a few insulin numbers are in the text (peak, iAUC); the time course is in a figure. Only in figures: insulin time course. Meal kinds: protein load, liquid meal.
